verdicts.strongest_argument: I will not score this high, because an absence genuinely cannot be published and nothing in the capture draws it out - but I will not score it low either, because it is close to information-free and the hunter half says so. The whole EDGAR index is in filings.json, so the gap after 2026-02-04 is reachable by anyone who lists the filings, which is the 20-40 band. What makes it weak is that the finding's own alternative explanation is the likely one: a Rule 10b5-1 plan that ran monthly from November to February and then stopped is what an expiring twelve-month plan looks like, and no replacement plan is required to be announced. The claim also has no size at all - not one share count or dollar value for any of the five 144/Form 4 pairs is stored - so even read as a signal it is a signal of unknown magnitude at a $205m issuer. And the buyback corroboration undercuts rather than supports it: if the company's May guidance already pointed publicly to 'potential for renewed share buybacks as cash generation exceeds expectations' with $80.5m of cash and no debt, then the capital-return story is published (seekingalpha, 2026-05-23) and the insider-selling halt adds nothing to it. Finally, the argument that the halt cannot be priced because the stock fell 54% from its high across the same window is run-up-as-evidence and would prove the opposite just as easily.

verdicts.strongest_argument: Six company press releases in eight weeks is the opposite of unpublished. Every item the finding lists - the Zoom Contact Center agent (06-25), the Deloitte knowledge-crisis report (06-22), Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader (07-21), the Unigarant win (08-11), the Stevie Awards (08-12/13) and the AI knowledge ARR statement (08-16) - is a company-issued announcement, at least two of them carried by Yahoo Finance (the 08-16 ARR piece and the Unigarant piece are both cited to finance.yahoo.com), and all of them reach me through the stored body docs/d429dbeec7ed4ef9374b66c21148a175c38c3ac2.txt. Company-issued proof points distributed on a wire and then indexed in a captured stream are the 70-85 band by construction. What the finding actually observes is that the market did not care - and it quotes the reason from its own corpus: '7% revenue growth for a company selling AI agents is terrible' and 'growth here absolutely sucks'. A market that has read the announcements and decided the consolidated growth rate matters more than the mix is a market that has priced them, not one that has missed them. The Gartner Leader argument is the strongest residual - recognition in a category can lengthen or shorten enterprise cycles - but that effect shows up in bookings over several quarters, not in a fiscal-year-end print six weeks later, and the finding offers no ARR figure, no dollar value for Unigarant and no growth-rate delta, so there is no magnitude to weigh against the disappointing headline growth the market is already looking at.
